title: Terraform CI: IaC Sanity Checker and Safe-Apply Agent for Private/VPC
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Ship a hardened CI component that performs lightweight IaC sanity checks, policy-as-code validation (OPA/Conftest), drift-sensitive plan gating, and a controlled 'safe-apply' agent for Private/VPC Terraform pipelines. This work covers: linting & fmt enforcement, modular plan scoring, deterministic drift probes, canary-safe apply orchestration, and an automated rollback path when preflight checks fail during Dedicated/Private upgrades. The feature must operate reliably in our self-hosted CI runners as well as cloud-hosted pipeline agents used by enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline runs 'tffmt/tflint' and fails PRs with formatting/lint errors
Policy-as-code (Conftest + OPA bundles) evaluate plans and return a numeric risk score; scores >= 70 block apply
Safe-Apply agent can perform canary apply to N% of Private environments and trigger automatic rollback on post-apply health regression within configured window
Plan-artifact signing and immutable plan execution: apply only allowed against an approved plan artifact linked to the PR
Drift probe step runs pre-apply and post-apply and flags unexpected deltas in networking/security resources
Runbooks and auto-remediation hooks documented in Confluence and linked from pipeline failure alerts
comments: 2026-02-11 - Ava Chen: Kickoff sync with Infra and Security. Agreed to standardize on Conftest for policy checks and keep OPA bundles for complex rules that run in the policy-engine service.

2026-02-13 - Diego Martinez: Prototype pipeline in a feature branch that runs tflint/tfsec, generates terraform plan JSON, and pipes to conftest. Found a false-positive for cross-account IAM roles; added a policy exception pattern to security team review.

2026-02-15 - Priya Singh (Security): Requested a policy gating threshold and a review process for gating overrides. Agreed on numeric score + manual override with audit trail; overrides require two approvers for high-risk applies.

2026-02-17 - Diego Martinez: Implemented 'plan artifact' signing using our existing artifact storage and a short-lived apply token. Proof-of-concept: apply runner enforces artifact ID + signature before executing terraform apply.

2026-02-19 - QA: Added a test harness deploying a VPC in a sandbox org to validate canary apply + drift detection. Observed spike in route-table changes after apply; added an additional pre-apply diff filter to ignore provider-managed tags.

2026-02-20 - Product (Lena Park): Prioritize ship for early enterprise adopters in March. Need documentation for on-prem runner setup and KMS integration for signing keys. Security review scheduled next week.
decision_log: We will standardize on Conftest for fast policy checks in PR pipelines and use OPA/rego bundles for the centralized policy evaluator service. 'Safe-Apply' will be a pipeline agent that enforces: signed plan artifact, policy score gating, canary execution (configurable percentage), health probe window post-apply, and automated rollback hooks that call orchestration API to revert to previous state or run compensating changes. Manual overrides allowed only with 2 approvers and are fully auditable.
next_steps: 1) Finalize Conftest policy set and threshold scoring matrix. 2) Add plan artifact signing using KMS-backed keys. 3) Build safe-apply agent container + runner integration. 4) Create canary rollout orchestration spec and include health probe hooks. 5) Run internal dogfood on sandbox private account and collect telemetry.
risks: 1) False-positive policies could block critical security fixes; mitigated by escape hatch with 2 approvers and audit. 2) Plan signing complexity for different CI runners and customer on-prem networks. 3) Rollback safety for networking changes (carve-outs for stateful infra) requires cautious canary config.
notes: This ticket intentionally scopes the CI/runtime enforcement piece. Separate follow-ups will implement UI in Console for configuring canary percentages and policy thresholds per workspace. Coordinate with customer success for early adopter onboarding.
